chunks: I have been sent as a trusted messenger to you.

key_terms.رَسُولٌ: Messenger, one sent with a divine message

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet mean when he calls himself a trusted messenger?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine guarantee of the Prophet's trustworthiness (Amanah), linking his personal integrity to the authenticity of the revelation. It serves as a foundational proof for the infallibility (Ismah) of the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt, assuring the community that the message conveyed is free from distortion or personal bias.
